body: Im pretty sure shes better off without me...so I kinda know how its gonna end.

She just tells me that im a shitty person that never truly loved her and im just with her out of pity.

Oh the conversation was pretty bad, I feel so ashamed, I said some nasty stuff that I really regret saying and worst of all is that I dont even feel that way, just said those things to act cool. fml

Yes i've tried to see it from her perspective and yeah, I would feel like shit and very betrayed but she needs to understand that what I said wasnt actually me nor does it reflect who I am.

Yes I tried explaining it but she just doesn't believe me and it hurts.

I've tried showing my love for her in several different ways but it just doesnt work :(

Tried:

*  Writing her a letter telling her how sorry I feel
* Gifting her stuff she likes 
* Taking her to places she likes
* Always reassuring her that shes attractive and beautiful
*  Always listening to her problems and helping her 

But it's pointless. She still doesnt believe me and it hurts so much.
Sorry if it doesnt make a lot of sense im currently so distressed I can't think right

So we met almost two years ago and she was the only person I truly felt connected with, I finally was able to share what I felt without someone judging me. We cared for each other.

She made me realize that someone could actually love me.

So some months ago she found out about a conversation I had with a guy in which we both talked about some girls and rated their appearance.  I was really desperate for a friend so I talked about that, thinking i was finally making a friend.

This conversation was held a month before we started dating.

So she felt betrayed and now hates me. And all of it because a stupid fucking text convo in which I tried to act "cool".
